referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A monochrome full-viewport couple photograph is overlaid with a centered serif invitation, date line and quiet response action. Tiny spaced event-story, day, travel, stay, gift and RSVP links sit over the image. High-contrast editorial serif for names and chapter titles, small uppercase labels and modest practical body copy. Warm paper, near-black, muted blush and photographic gray. A single hero, landscape story photograph and irregular floral/event mosaic lead the page. The full sequence runs from centered photo invitation to couple story split to ruled day timeline toward RSVP form, gift options, small footer. Couple identity, dates, guest details, venue address, gift requests and RSVP claims are fictional template data.
